throughput.name: 8 independent lanes, best-case operands
throughput.asm: frsqrt.s $f0, $f8; frsqrt.s $f1, $f9; frsqrt.s $f2, $f10; frsqrt.s $f3, $f11; frsqrt.s $f4, $f12; frsqrt.s $f5, $f13; frsqrt.s $f6, $f14; frsqrt.s $f7, $f15
throughput.init: li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f8, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f9, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f10, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f11, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f12, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f13, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f14, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f15, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --init 'li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f8, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f9, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f10, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f11, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f12, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f13, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f14, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f15, $r4' --asm 'frsqrt.s $f0, $f8; frsqrt.s $f1, $f9; frsqrt.s $f2, $f10; frsqrt.s $f3, $f11; frsqrt.s $f4, $f12; frsqrt.s $f5, $f13; frsqrt.s $f6, $f14; frsqrt.s $f7, $f15'
throughput.notes: Data-dependent. 8 independent lanes. CPI ~2.25 for special values, ~3.25 for exact squares, ~7.75 for general inputs, up to ~8.0 with maxsub/minsub. CPI is unchanged for 1-20 independent lanes; mixed fast/slow lanes are additive. Both ends are recorded as separate experiments, so the range is the spread between them.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes, worst-case operands
throughput.asm: frsqrt.s $f0, $f16; frsqrt.s $f1, $f16; frsqrt.s $f2, $f16; frsqrt.s $f3, $f16; frsqrt.s $f4, $f16; frsqrt.s $f5, $f16; frsqrt.s $f6, $f16; frsqrt.s $f7, $f16
throughput.command: ./bench --method slope --unroll 250 --unroll2 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 10 --init 'li.d $r4, 1073741824; movgr2fr.w $f16, $r4' --asm 'frsqrt.s $f0, $f16; frsqrt.s $f1, $f16; frsqrt.s $f2, $f16; frsqrt.s $f3, $f16; frsqrt.s $f4, $f16; frsqrt.s $f5, $f16; frsqrt.s $f6, $f16; frsqrt.s $f7, $f16'
throughput.notes: Operands chosen to hit the longest latency class of this instruction; the first experiment uses the shortest. Raw measurement was 62.06 cycles, rounded to 7.75 CPI.

notes: Latency and throughput are data-dependent. The latency range was re-measured with unroll=100000; unroll=1000 produced values about 0.2 cycles lower because the per-call overhead was not fully amortised. Throughput is initiation-interval bound: CPI is unchanged from 1 to 20 independent lanes, and mixed fast/slow lanes are additive.
